newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia central bank raises interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia central bank raises interest rates.

text.p: Indonesian central bank, bank Indonesia, said on Tuesday it has raised the rates for bilateral central bank certificates (SBIs) of maturities between one-week and three-months.
One official said one-week bilateral SBIs rose to 20 percent from 10.5, two to 22 percent from 11 percent, one-month to 30 percent from 11.625 and three to 28 percent from 11.5 percent.
The official told Reuters that overnight money was maintained at 15.0 percent and the two-to-six day SBIs at 16.0 percent.
He said six-month and one-year bilateral SBIs were maintained at 12.125 and 12.75 percent, respectively.
Currency dealers said the move was aimed at containing local speculative dollar buying.
